color_story: One saturated spring green floats on a green-black void, a single direction lit in the dark, because the phrase is about picking one and not hedging. The hue sits at 160, inside the 140-180 target; it overlaps the computed forbidden band 118-218, but the formula (dark-void, not another green drench) is what breaks the recent sameness, and the target range was the explicit instruction.
